column2: I'm starting to lose hair, a lot of hair.
Well Lena, you've been through a lot lately
Hair loss is a common symptom of stress and anxiety.
No, no! This is something else, the way it falls out.
It happens during the night, I can feel something pulling my hair out.
But when I wake up it's just gone.
There's no trace of the pulled out hair.
Do you think someone is pulling your hair out?
What reason would someone in your house have to do that?
It's not a person, it's not human.
I can feel it watching me while I sleep.
I understand, this "being", have you seen it?
Anxiety can not only make you lose your hair.
Sometimes it makes us feel things that aren't really there.
